name: Gitea
description: Self-hosted git service — repos, issues, pull requests, and built-in SSH server for git over SSH
author: Crow

env_vars.name: GITEA_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Personal access token (Settings > Applications > Generate New Token)

notes: Crow creates Gitea's admin account (crow-admin) itself at install and saves the password in Settings → Passwords; the web installer at /install is closed by GITEA__security__INSTALL_LOCK in the compose file, which existing installs receive at the next gateway start (then Restart the app in Extensions). Log in as crow-admin and generate a personal access token under Settings > Applications for GITEA_TOKEN. Git over SSH uses port 2223: clone with ssh://git@host:2223/user/repo.git (the scp-style git@host:user/repo silently hits port 22 and will not reach this bundle).
